transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Hi! Welcome to ConversalQ. What can I help you with?

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.text: Hi, I'm evaluating your product for our startup. Can you tell me what the AI call center assistant does exactly?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Of course! ConversalQ is an AI-powered call center platform. It uses a multi-agent system to automatically route customer enquiries to the right specialist — billing, technical support, account management, or general support. It handles both voice calls and chat, and learns from your knowledge base to give accurate, grounded answers.

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.text: Can it handle voice calls too, not just chat?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Yes! We have full voice integration via Twilio. Customers can call your number, and our AI handles the conversation end-to-end with speech recognition. If needed, it escalates to a human agent seamlessly.

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.text: What about language support? Our customers are in the US and Spain.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Currently English is fully supported with high accuracy. Spanish support is in beta — our AI agents can understand and respond in Spanish, though we recommend testing with your specific use cases. Full Spanish GA is planned for Q3.

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.text: That's good to know. Is there a free trial?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Yes! We offer a 14-day free trial with full Pro features — no credit card required. You can sign up at conversalq.com/trial. Our onboarding team will also reach out to help you get set up.

transcript.speaker: customer
transcript.text: Great, I'll try it out. Thank you!

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: You're welcome! Feel free to reach out if you have questions during your trial.
